name: Jari Mäkinen
bio:
Jari's journey into motorsport began in his teens, tinkering with engines in his father's garage in rural Finland. He quickly developed a knack for understanding mechanical systems and a passion for racing. After completing his vocational training in automotive engineering, he worked for a small rally team before making the leap to open-wheel racing. His meticulous attention to detail and ability to adapt quickly to new technologies made him a valuable asset to several European teams. 

He joined Team Penske after impressing their scouts at a fabrication competition, drawn to the team's unwavering pursuit of excellence. Jari approaches his role with a quiet determination, focusing on precision and efficiency. He's known for his creative problem-solving skills and his ability to visualize complex designs in his head. While he's not the loudest voice in the garage, his contributions are essential to the team's success, always pushing the boundaries of what's mechanically possible.
